build_VisionTransformer_base: build a VisionTransformer backbone with base architecture for image feature extraction
build_VisionTransformer_custom_arch: build a VisionTransformer with custom embed_dims, num_layers, num_heads, and feedforward_channels
build_VisionTransformer_sapiens: build a VisionTransformer using sapiens_0.3b, sapiens_0.6b, or sapiens_1b pretrained architecture
forward_VisionTransformer: forward an image tensor through a VisionTransformer and extract cls_token or featmap output
freeze_VisionTransformer_stages: freeze the first N stages of a VisionTransformer backbone for transfer learning
